{{WorldTableTennisChampionshipsEvents|year=2015}}
{{main article|2015 World Table Tennis Championships}}

The '''2015 World Table Tennis Championships mixed doubles''' was the 53rd edition of the mixed doubles championship.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.allabouttabletennis.com/world-table-tennis-championships-medal-winners.html|title=List of Winners|publisher=All About Table Tennis}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.ittf.com/museum/WorldChResultsXD.pdf|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20120609224957/http://www.ittf.com/museum/WorldChResultsXD.pdf|url-status=dead|archive-date=2012-06-09|title=Mixed doubles results|publisher=International Table Tennis Federation}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|url=http://sports123.com/tte/index.html|title=Table Tennis World Championship medal winners|publisher=Sports123|access-date=2018-04-01|archive-date=2018-09-22|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180922055935/http://sports123.com/tte/index.html|url-status=dead}}</ref>

[[Kim Hyok-bong]] and [[Kim Jong (table tennis)|Kim Jong]] were the defending champions but lost in the semifinals and secured a bronze medal.<ref>[http://www.ittf.com/ittf_tournaments/ittf_entries_mix_wttc_web.asp?Gender=M&Tour_ID=2503&Mix=1 Entry list]</ref>

[[Xu Xin (table tennis)|Xu Xin]] and [[Yang Ha-eun]] won the gold medal in the final against [[Maharu Yoshimura]] and [[Kasumi Ishikawa]] by a score of 11–7, 11–8, 11–4, 11–6.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.ittf.com/_front_page/ittf_full_story1.asp?ID=39522&Competition_ID=2503&|title=Successful Debut, Xu Xin and Yang Haeun Write History in Suzhou|date=1 May 2015|work=ittf.com}}</ref>

==Seeds==
Matches were best of 7 games in qualification and in the 128-player sized main draw.<ref>[http://www.ittf.com//World_Events/wttc_2015/Playing%20system_WTTC2015.pdf Playing system]</ref><ref>[http://www.ittf.com/ittf_tournaments/ittf_entries_mix_wttc_web.asp?Gender=M&Tour_ID=2503&Seeded_Mix=1&FormParticipants_Sorting=26&FormParticipants_Sorted=& Seeds]</ref>
